title: Binary Search
summary: Find a target value in a sorted array and return its index.
algorithmSteps: Track inclusive left and right boundaries.
Compare the target with the middle value.
Discard the half that cannot contain the target and repeat.

examples.explanation: The target 9 is stored at index 4.

edgeCases: Return -1 when the target is absent.
The input array may be empty.
The array must already be sorted in ascending order.
